scripts.lint:test-policy: DIRS=$(find . \( -path '*/node_modules' -o -path '*/dist' -o -path '*/repos' -o -path '*/docs' \) -prune -o \( -name test -o -name __tests__ \) -type d -print); grep -rEn --include='*.test.ts' --include='*.test.tsx' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=dist --exclude-dir=repos --exclude-dir=docs 'vi\.mock|vi\.spyOn|vi\.fn\b|\.mock\.calls|vi\.mocked|toHaveBeenCalled|mockResolvedValue|mockReturnValue|mockImplementation|mockRejectedValue' .; G1=$?; if [ -n "$DIRS" ]; then grep -rEn --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=dist --exclude-dir=repos --exclude-dir=docs 'vi\.mock|vi\.spyOn|vi\.fn\b|\.mock\.calls|vi\.mocked|toHaveBeenCalled|mockResolvedValue|mockReturnValue|mockImplementation|mockRejectedValue' $DIRS; G2=$?; else G2=1; fi; [ "$G1" -eq 1 ] && [ "$G2" -eq 1 ]
scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm exec vitest run --project root
